finding: One-off revenue flatters 2025 growth. Headline revenue growth is 22.8%; recurring revenue grew 12.1% and revenue excluding the 45 'other implementation' invoices billed in 2025 grew 11.9%. Price increases carry a large part of recurring growth. Every recurring line was billed 5% more from January 2024 and a further 7% from January 2025. ARR grew 10.3% in 2025, 3.1% before the price increase (14.4% and 8.9% in 2024). The price increase added £2.31m of ARR in 2025; upsell was £0.
